answer: The dawn is the proof of the hands, the grove is the proof of the purse, and the crystal is the proof of the years, and proofs do not share. The guild book outlives the farm, the bench price outlasts the epoch, and the test stays open. An alias is not free: 88 POA and 15 minutes buys one, and 516 of them cost 45408 POA and 7740 minutes. The record that outlives the epoch is Patented forest warden deer count file with county assize attestation, and it is written in 6-year stewardship, 41 supervised woodlands, wardenship assessment, keeping dues.
